doc:
# Replica — Black Hole Information

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “replica wormhole”).

claims.name: integer_replica_index_global_symmetry
claims.statement: At integer replica index, global symmetry violating effects manifest themselves as charge flowing through the replica wormhole.

sources.title: Signatures of global symmetry violation in relative entropies and replica wormholes

claims.name: wormhole_saddle_connects_different_boundaries
claims.statement: A wormhole saddle connects different boundaries through the AdS bulk, analogous to a 3d replica wormhole.

sources.title: Holographic BCFT with a Defect on the End-of-the-World Brane

claims.name: replicawormhole_derivation_given_first_proposal
claims.statement: A replica-wormhole derivation is given for the first proposal.

claims.name: replica_wormhole_saddle_reproduces_entropy
claims.statement: The replica wormhole saddle reproduces the entropy of the island rule.

sources.title: Replica Wormholes and the Entropy of Hawking Radiation

claims.name: replica_wormhole_topology_has_saddle
claims.statement: The replica wormhole topology has a saddle point at finite $n$.

sources.title: Replica Wormholes and the Entropy of Hawking Radiation

claims.name: holographic_duality_longtime_solution_corresponds
claims.statement: In holographic duality, the long-time solution corresponds to a replica wormhole.

sources.title: Replica wormhole and information retrieval in the SYK model coupled to Majorana chains

claims.name: entanglement_islands_arise_connected_wormhole
claims.statement: Entanglement islands arise from connected wormhole saddles in a gravitational replica trick.

claims.name: replica_wormhole_saddle_gives_textrm
claims.statement: The replica wormhole saddle gives $\textrm{Tr}[\rho^{2}]|_{\rm Wormhole~saddle}= (\textrm{Tr}[\rho])^{2}$ and therefore has zero entropy.

claims.name: general_structure_resulting_realtime_replica
claims.statement: The general structure of the resulting real-time replica wormhole saddles is described.

sources.title: Real-time gravitational replicas: Formalism and a variational principle

claims.name: replica_wormhole_regarded_transition_between
claims.statement: The replica wormhole can be regarded as a transition between different degenerate vacua.

sources.title: Replica wormhole as a vacuum-to-vacuum transition

claims.name: replica_wormhole_geometries_multiple_qes
claims.statement: Replica wormhole geometries with multiple QES are described using the theory of Fuchsian uniformisation.

sources.title: Replica Rényi Wormholes and Generalised Modular Entropy in JT Gravity

claims.name: paper_argues_spacetimewormhole_contributions_replicabased
claims.statement: The paper argues that spacetime-wormhole contributions to replica-based entropy and correlator calculations are controlled by wormhole calculus plus standard quantum prescriptions, yielding definite and restricted replica-connection rules rather than a sum over all replica-connecting topologies. This challenges the assumption that all such topologies must be included.

claims.name: late_times_twointerval_replica_wormhole
claims.statement: At late times in the two-interval replica wormhole for eternal black holes, the wormhole factorizes into two copies of the one-interval solution.

sources.title: Replica wormholes for an evaporating 2D black hole

claims.name: violation_stems_operator_insertions_forming
claims.statement: The violation stems from operator insertions forming singlets on replica wormhole while disconnected contribution vanishes

sources.title: A violation of global symmetries from replica wormholes and the fate of black hole remnants

claims.name: explicit_replica_wormhole_identified_mechanism
claims.statement: An explicit replica wormhole is identified as the mechanism diagnosing the island and restoring unitarity.

sources.title: The Entanglement Wedge of Unknown Couplings

claims.name: quantitative_notion_irreversibility_hawking_radiation
claims.statement: A quantitative notion of irreversibility in Hawking radiation is formulated using the replica--wormhole paradigm.

sources.title: Zeno's paradox and black hole information loss problem

claims.name: replica_wormhole_introduces_nontrivial_entanglement
claims.statement: The replica wormhole introduces a non-trivial entanglement wedge for the bath after Page time.

sources.title: Theory dependence of black hole interior reconstruction and the extended strong subadditivity

claims.name: equations_control_replica_wormhole_saddle
claims.statement: The equations that control the replica wormhole saddle point can be analytically continued to non-integer $n$ and used to define the replica limit $n \to 1$.

sources.title: Replica Wormholes and the Entropy of Hawking Radiation
